name: Desktop-MCP
description: Visible, supervised Windows desktop control built on Windows-MCP
long_description: One locally armed session combines desktop control and teaching: smooth input, adaptive screenshots, laser/ink guidance and learner cursor waits. A two-way transcript opens with the app and has a main-panel visibility toggle. An active MCP agent can listen for typed questions and reply there. Chat works while desktop control is paused; only the human can arm or resume input. Python 3.14+ required.

screenshot_backend.title: Screenshot backend
screenshot_backend.description: auto selects DXGI, MSS or Pillow. Use mss or pillow if the display driver cannot supply captures.

tools.name: DesktopStatus
tools.description: Read controller state without capturing the screen.

tools.name: DesktopStop
tools.description: Latch a stop and release owned input. Resume is local-only.

tools.name: DesktopControl

tools.name: DesktopBatch
tools.description: Serial validated input steps with one final observation.

tools.name: Screenshot
tools.description: Efficient image observations with safe coordinate references.

tools.name: Click
tools.description: Smooth movement and left/right/middle/extra-button clicks.

tools.name: Move
tools.description: Accelerated pointer movement and modifier-aware drags.

tools.name: Type

tools.name: Wait

tools.name: App

tools.name: Transcript
